run_deep_cfr_solver: run Deep CFR solver on a game like kuhn_poker with configurable iterations and traversals
create_deep_cfr_solver: create a DeepCFRSolver instance with policy and advantage neural network layers for iterative solving
solve_game_with_deep_cfr: solve a game using Deep CFR and retrieve advantage losses and policy loss values
compute_nash_conv: compute Nash convergence of a trained Deep CFR policy against the average strategy
evaluate_policy_values: evaluate expected game score values for each player using the computed average policy
